name: post_reorder_deepgemm
description: Gather-and-reduce DeepGEMM expert outputs into token rows. down_output is [num_tokens*topk, hidden_size], src2dst/topk_ids/topk_weights are [num_tokens, topk], and output is a preallocated [num_tokens, hidden_size] tensor. For each token and slot k, out[t,h] = routed_scaling_factor * sum_k down_output[src2dst[t,k],h] * topk_weights[t,k] for slots with topk_ids[t,k] >= 0; invalid (-1) slots contribute exactly zero. Accumulation is float32 and the result is cast to output.dtype. The kernel writes output in place and returns that same tensor. Suites exercise bfloat16 down_output/output, int32 indices and float32 weights.
